prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a cluster of roasted chestnuts, their textured, golden-brown shells glistening under soft, diffused lighting. Wisps of steam curl and drift gracefully across the frame, emphasizing the warmth and freshness of the chestnuts. The focus is shallow, with the foreground chestnuts rendered in sharp detail while the background blurs into a gentle bokeh, creating a sense of depth and intimacy. The color palette is warm and earthy, dominated by creamy tans, deep browns, and subtle highlights that catch the contours of the shells. The overall mood is cozy and inviting, evoking the sensory experience of freshly roasted food. The composition is tight and immersive, with the camera positioned at a low angle, almost at the level of the chestnuts, drawing the viewer into the scene and highlighting the tactile, aromatic qualities of the subject.
